verdict.rationale: Codex CLI is an official, well-documented CLI (npm install -g @openai/codex) with extensive commands for coding tasks, sandboxing, MCP integration, cloud task delegation, and non-interactive exec mode, backed by first-party docs and GitHub repo, plus community usage confirming real-world adoption. Missing for 10: independent benchmark/hands-on verification specifically of CLI features (most community evidence is about model quality rather than CLI usability itself).
